Dayana Barboza.
Art as a lifestyle.

bio.hook: I started painting jackets simply with the intention of making a special gift, without thinking about techniques or materials—I just wanted to give something made with my own hands. From that spark, Amazing Project was born: a journey that began without feeling completely prepared, without art degrees, without experience.
paragraphs: I started painting jackets simply with the intention of making a special gift, without thinking about techniques or materials—I just wanted to give something made with my own hands. From that spark, Amazing Project was born: a journey that began without feeling completely prepared, without art degrees, without experience.

Five years have passed since then, and it still takes me by surprise when people call me an artist. But time has taught me that art needs neither academies, nor galleries, nor accolades. What art truly needs is patience, discipline, and countless attempts.
Art also demands continuous learning, and great wisdom to navigate both the rush of inspiration and the weight of frustration.
Art is an uninhibited form of expression, and its beauty lives in the eyes of whoever beholds it.
Art is so generous that it gives you permission to call yourself an Artist.
bio.quote: I believe in the woman who chooses to build her dream, who dares to take risks and try. And I believe there are beautiful stories that deserve to be painted.
